units.source_text: 我本来期望她能在与我邂逅的这种命运中预感到一点什么，期望她哪怕是稍许给我接近世界没落助以一臂之力。

en.t: I had originally hoped that, in the fate of her encounter with me, she might sense something in advance, and that she might help me, even slightly, to draw closer to the collapse of the world.

units.source_text: 我觉得对她来说，这不应是无关紧要的事。

en.t: I felt that, for her, this should not be a matter of no importance.

units.source_text: 这种焦虑的结果，我终于说出了不应该说的事。

en.t: As a result of this anxiety, I finally said what I should not have said.
